name: Optimizely Rollouts
description: Optimizely Rollouts is the free Optimizely Feature Experimentation plan for feature flags, targeted deliveries, gradual rollouts, and limited experimentation.
agentUseSummary: Connect a personal access token owned by a dedicated Viewer collaborator and bind it to one non-production Feature Experimentation project. Relay approval-gates first-page active flag and exact flag metadata reads while rollout rules, environments, variables, identities, roles, evaluation, legacy APIs, and mutations remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: OPTIMIZELY_ROLLOUTS_VIEWER_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Optimizely Rollouts Viewer personal access token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated collaborator with Viewer project, environment, and flag roles.

credentialRequirements.name: OPTIMIZELY_ROLLOUTS_PROJECT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Optimizely Rollouts project ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind Relay to one non-production Feature Experimentation project.

capabilities.label: Read flag metadata
capabilities.description: Read bounded project flag metadata with approval.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Personal access tokens and authorization headers never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Read rollout configuration or people
blocked.description: Environment states, rules, audiences, experiments, variables and defaults, variations, metrics, user identities, account IDs, roles, URNs, and mutation links are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate Optimizely
blocked.description: Flag, rule, rollout, experiment, environment, audience, variable, token, project, and every other mutation remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only current Feature Experimentation /flags/v1 first-page active flag list and exact GETs run on api.optimizely.com with stored project binding; legacy /v2/features, arbitrary paths, queries, pagination, evaluation, and datafile access are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Both metadata reads require approval; Viewer authority, fixed current API/project routes, bounds, redaction, audits, and rollout/evaluation/mutation blocks remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected metadata read runs without Relay approval; Viewer authority, fixed current API/project routes, bounds, redaction, audits, and rollout/evaluation/mutation blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway attaches the encrypted Viewer token server-side and mounts two approval-gated metadata reads.

providerSetup.blocker: Optimizely Rollouts requires a customer account, dedicated Viewer collaborator/personal access token, and one Feature Experimentation project. This worker may not create or configure them.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create the restricted staging collaborator/token outside this worker, configure token and project ID in Railway staging, then verify binding, reads, redaction, approvals, bounds, revocation, disconnect, and denial.

evidence.supports: Optimizely documents Rollouts as the free Feature Experimentation plan and distinguishes the current product from sunset Full Stack legacy projects.
Optimizely's official guide pins /flags/v1 list/exact GETs, Bearer authentication, rich response fields, and separate mutation endpoints.
The current official API reference defines project binding, first-page controls, active/archive filters, pagination metadata, and authorization errors.
Optimizely documents Viewer project, environment, and flag roles as view-only without edit or publish permissions.
